cohort_policy_details: Select exact season/game_type and declared date range; retain every source-frame game in the inclusion/exclusion ledger.

Exclude an entire candidate game for quarantine/unreconstructed status, incomplete game, critical or unknown reconstruction quality, unknown outcome, flagged/incomplete row provenance, or unassigned live control.
Retain explicit administrative unassigned references when unassigned_control_events is exactly false; no source rows disappear.
Preserve all selected game rows, original possession numbers and supplied prior-global histories; never drop individual outcomes or reindex.
Keep numeric/history nulls explicit; the model uses the existing fixed missing indicators and training-only imputation.
Selection is provisional data availability/quality, not scientific eligibility; conditional selection may bias results.
limitations: Local plan saved before the first fit; not an authenticated preregistration or an unused confirmatory cohort.
Reconstruction and every game remain independently unvalidated; no independent audit or 1% game-error bound is claimed.

Paired whole-game intervals condition on fitted/development-selected models and selected games, assuming independent identically distributed games; no training/selection/calendar correction or guaranteed coverage.
Only retrospective prediction of recorded counted defensive fouls; no call-correctness, referee-intent or causal conclusion.
Actual model results and generated explorer stay in ignored local outputs; no deployment or public scientific claim.

model_specification.missing: numeric constant zero plus fixed missing indicators; categorical unknown sentinel
model_specification.nonlinear: clock/720 squared; margin/30 squared; margin/30 times clock/720; home times margin/30
model_specification.selection: tune possession logloss; first grid value breaks ties; no train+tune refit
